description: Server-side JavaScript code for a database visualization dashboard, implementing API endpoints for database connection testing, retrieving table lists, and fetching table data across multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It includes environment variable loading, database adapter classes, and Express server setup.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for database adapters, defining interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and fetching data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, providing common SQL query execution methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing getTables and getData methods using MongoClient.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and returns list of successful ones.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing database operations and returning JSON responses.
